podcast.title: Derivation from Ambient House
podcast.body: Ambient Techno emerged as a direct derivative of Ambient House, originating from dance music during the mid-1990s. This genre represented a further diversification of electronic music, blending the atmospheric qualities of ambient sounds with the rhythmic structures of techno. "El Ambient House se volvió muy popular rápidamente, derivando a otros géneros que también tienen su origen en la música de baile, como el Ambient Techno."
